title: Unauthenticated and spoofed-role access permits writes
reproduction: POST /rooms without a token returns201; X-User-Role:Administrator also returns201. Defaults adapt roles to each route; X-User-Id is trusted.
impact: Any caller can change scheduling data and impersonate actor IDs.
action: Verify JWT/session; load active user and roles from trusted storage; reject missing identity.

title: Generated timetable can contain simultaneous instructor, room and batch clashes
reproduction: API accepts overlapping weekly slot201. A two-slot engine dataset with both windows08:00-09:00 returns optimal, two entries for instructor1/batch1/room2 and validator[].
impact: A schedule advertised as conflict-free can double-book all three resources in actual clock time.
action: Reject overlapping/irregular grids and independently check real temporal overlap.

title: Mixed explicit and inferred exam enrollments miss required conflict edges
reproduction: Take two same-batch offerings; fully enumerate students for one and leave the other unenumerated. First course has student:* identities; second has batch:* only. Graph edge is absent.
impact: Under A-4 the same real cohort can be assigned clashing exams; validator uses same flawed membership helper and will miss the same overlap.
action: Represent inferred membership using known batch students plus conservative cohort relations; test mixed, partial, repeater and elective data.

title: Published timetable can be invalidated through master-data updates
reproduction: In isolated fixture mark schedule1 Published with approval metadata, PUT /rooms/1 capacity1 returns200. Reloading that published version produces H04 violations. Direct entry edits correctly return409.
impact: The published schedule ceases to satisfy hard constraints without new generation, validation or approval; historical views use mutable master data.
action: Snapshot immutable version inputs or block/version invalidating metadata changes and revalidate authoritative publication.

title: Lab validator accepts clock-time gaps as consecutive
reproduction: Keep lab slot indexes consecutive but change final lab slot to18:00-19:00; validator returns[].
impact: An hours-long lab interruption passes hard validation.
action: Require previous end_time==next start_time for every lab block; validate grid topology.

title: Unpublished and other-batch schedules exposed; Administrator permitted scheduling
reproduction: Student with X-Batch-Id1 reads Generated schedule with26 entries; list shows Generated; Administrator generation returns202. Pages initialize all scopes.
impact: Disclosure of drafts/other cohorts and violation of stated separation of duties.
action: Enforce status/ownership at list/detail/entries/export; Coordinator generates, Approver publishes, Administrator administers.

title: Unlinked Faculty can edit any instructor availability
reproduction: X-User-Role:Faculty with no instructor link PUT instructor2 availability returns200. Read route also lacks own-scope guard.
impact: Faculty can alter another instructor input.
action: Require trusted non-null Faculty link and scope read/write to it.

title: Publication and archiving only exist in browser overlay
reproduction: Publish route404. publishOverlay sets Published and prior Archived in a Map; refresh/new client loses state and no Approver server check executes.
impact: Users may believe a version is official while database still says Generated.
action: Implement transactional Approver publish/archive with independent live validation.

title: CSV import validates mock records and can report inserts it never performs
evidence: POST /import/courses404 executed; remaining behavior static inspection
reproduction: Real-mode import still calls mock.validateImport/confirmImport. confirmImport has only course/instructor/room/batch insert branches but reports job.rows.length for offerings/enrollments.
impact: No imported records reach authoritative database; offering/enrollment imports can report false success even in mock mode.
action: Implement staged server validation/confirmation, complete FK checks and truthful counts.

title: Schedule PDF/CSV export buttons have no download behavior
evidence: Both export endpoint probes return404; buttons statically traced
reproduction: Both schedule pages use ExportActions, whose callbacks only emit status text. ConflictReportPage has a distinct real client CSV download.
impact: Users cannot produce required schedules for printing/distribution.
action: Add authorized PDF/CSV exporters, metadata/filters and audit events.

title: Login/accounts/audit screens simulate security without server persistence
evidence: Auth/users/audit endpoint probes404; static mock login check
reproduction: Known mock username plus any nonempty password succeeds; saveUser discards password. UI starts as Administrator and allows arbitrary role switching; no logout/password lifecycle.
impact: Prototype identity and security records cannot establish a real authenticated session.
action: Replace security mocks with authenticated server workflows, bcrypt>=12, expiry and lockout.

title: Cancellation, total deadlines and process isolation are incomplete
evidence: Static control-flow finding; no stress benchmark executed
reproduction: Cancel stops UI following only. BackgroundTasks is same-process execution; repeated5s room/diagnostic solves and unconstrained backtracking exceed a single global deadline; timetable diagnosis adds2s/rule.
impact: Run may continue after cancellation and consume shared resources beyond stated budget.
action: Use a cancellable process worker and shared monotonic deadline covering preflight/build/search/diagnostics/validation.

title: Default production app skips startup recovery of orphaned runs
reproduction: create_app() has no factory at lifespan start; factory is initialized by first request after recovery phase. Isolated patched engine probe leaves status Generating.
impact: Restarted runs remain indefinitely Generating in default deployment.
action: Initialize configured engine/session factory before startup recovery and test default entrypoint.

title: Backend regeneration never supplies previous timetable to S05
evidence: Static call tracing; direct-engine S05 test passes
reproduction: Worker discards all unlocked previous entries and calls solve_timetable without previous_schedule/previous_entries; S05 obtains empty list.
impact: Configured schedule-stability preference silently does nothing in real API regeneration.
action: Pass complete previous timetable to objective separately from mandatory locked entries.

title: Manual adjustment workflow lacks state/block/lock/override completeness
reproduction: Only Published/Archived forbidden; Generated-only rule not enforced. Multi-slot Move disabled; no lock/unlock UI; exam room selector/override persistence and undo absent.
impact: Core adjustment and repeatability workflow cannot be completed through UI; exam override history lost.
action: Atomic lab-block/exam room moves, Generated-only guard, persisted override flags, lock controls and undo snapshot.

title: Audit, schema lifecycle and database enforcement incomplete
evidence: Runtime metadata inventory; room mutation audit probe fails
reproduction: ORM metadata is missing leading FK indexes; schema.sql already defines those indexes and log/overlap/capacity/published-entry triggers, but create_all omits SQL-only definitions. No versioned migrations; ordinary room creation has no audit event; mandatory security services absent.
impact: Poor accountability, migration reproducibility and incomplete integrity guarantees.
action: Reconcile existing SQL-only indexes/triggers with ORM-created databases through tested migrations; complete trusted audit services and verify installed PostgreSQL grants.

title: Malformed time/grid input returns500 or misleading409
reproduction: not-a-time produces500;23:00 two-hour grid produces500; working_days[8] returns409 described as existing grid overlap.
impact: User cannot distinguish validation failure from server failure; robustness requirement violated.
action: Use typed time/domain validators and precise422 messages before constructing or committing rows.

title: Generation lacks snapshot/concurrency guarantees for versions and saving
evidence: Static race analysis; not reproduced under concurrent load
reproduction: Next version uses max+1 without serialization/retry; data is loaded then session closed before solve, later save does not revalidate against current data. Config/master changes may occur in between.
impact: Concurrent runs can collide with unhandled UNIQUE failure; stale input can yield a Generated version invalid against current data.
action: Atomically allocate versions, snapshot/hash inputs, reject stale results or validate under save-time consistency guarantees.

title: Configuration deletion is local and parameters lack domain validation
reproduction: Deletion only hides ID in a Set; arbitrary negative param_value and unknown rule code/type accepted by schema/service.
impact: Configuration may reappear or advertise a rule the engine does not enforce.
action: Implement persistent delete and catalogue-specific validation.

title: UI role, layout, localization and documentation remain incomplete
reproduction: All-batch parallel timetable entries share CSS grid cells; explicit term selector absent; dashboard actions not role-scoped; error IDs missing; local timezone rather than explicit Karachi; documentation and resource extraction incomplete.
impact: Unverified mobile/accessibility behavior and confusing scope/navigation/display.
action: Finish role-specific UX, rendering, explicit timezone/resources/help and execute browser/contrast tests.
